newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight business slacker, Brazil still focus.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight business slacker, Brazil still focus.

text.p: Business slackened on London's sugar freight market although demand for south Brazil was once again evident as the region pumped out its new crop shipments, shipbrokers said on Thursday.
The only new orders came from CSR and Cargill.
CSR quoted for 30,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Queensland to China for July 10/20 and Cargill was open for 14,000 tonnes in bags from Santos to east Africa/Red Sea for June 25/30.
Czarnikow Rionda provided the only fixture with a 14,000-tonne bagged cargo, also from south Brazil to east Africa for prompt dates. Rate details have yet to emerge.
